state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 3: every Core feature in the roster has a page.** Configuration, CLI and `--check reference` are still open.

`website/src/pages/reference/core/[...slug].astro` renders each class and member from `core.json`, the member's `about.md` and its examples. `website/src/lib/feature.ts` reads both in place, parses the `related:` line and fails the build on a name with no page. A section with nothing in it is left out. `website/README.md` § *How the Core reference works* is the home of the page's shape.

`tools/nv/renderers/website-core.ts` `addRegistryMembers` adds every registered class and member the spec's tables do not name, built from the registry's own signature. `core.json` now has 145 classes and 885 members, the same 885 the roster counts. The 299 spec-stated records are unchanged. The 16 registered classes with no member (`Core\Regex\Pattern`, `Core\Http\Lines` and others) have no page, and no roster feature either. `bun nv site --build` passes with them.

Nine members' `about.md` have a `related:` line. No other `about.md` has one yet.

`site structure` and `site stale` pass. `snippets` and `prose` still fail on the pages stages 5 and 6 rewrite.

items.text: **Configuration and CLI sub-areas, one page per `nvs.toml` block and per command.** The roster's config features are the 51 `directive:<key>` entries at `config/<block>[-<key>]`, blocks and keys both, plus the `tools:config/*` chapter sections. Its CLI features are `tools:cli/*`, `tools:server/nvs-*`, `tools:editor/*` and `tools:agents/*`; `tools:php-differences/*` and `tools:install/*` belong to In-Depth and Install. Goal § Stage 3 *Three sub-areas*. Anchors: `website/astro.config.ts:116`, `website/src/pages/reference/core/[...slug].astro:1`, `tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts:314`

**`--check reference`, replacing its "not written yet" entry in `LATER`.** It compares the roster's `member`, `directive` and CLI `tool` entries with the built pages, and `core.json` against a fresh render when a binary is built. Goal § Stage 3 *`--check reference`*. Anchor: `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts:64`

backlog: A class page's summary is the spec chapter's prose, with rule ids and internal words in it. The 119 registry-only classes use the class card's one sentence instead. A plain description needs a home — `website/src/components/ClassOverview.astro`.
`related:` lines for the other members where a reader clearly wants the link — goal § Stage 3 *Related*.
Stage 5, Install, Guides and the Notes app — goal § Stage 5.
Stage 6, In-Depth, the home page and the plain-English read — goal § Stage 6.
The wrap gate infers a stale page's cause from the paths changed. ADR 0262 § Revisiting names when to hash the card at the session's base instead.
